why_ai: Platform operations on screens, while generative tools substitute many templates and assets.
why_clarity: Payments and delivery are solved routines, but discovery and licence questions stay fuzzy.
why_digital: Digital files sold, delivered and supported entirely online.

why_ai: Representation and interaction are model-driven engineering problems.
why_clarity: The aesthetic query has no ground truth, though buyers reject wrong results instantly.
why_digital: Search over digital assets built and used entirely online.

why_ai: Both style matching and technical fit are model-driven search problems.
why_clarity: Searches repeat at volume with click and purchase feedback, but style intent is vague.
why_digital: Platform search engineering over a digital catalogue.

why_ai: Matching modified copies is a model and index problem, purely technical.
why_clarity: Match or no match against known assets is objective and testable at scale.
why_digital: Fingerprints computed over digital files found across the web.

why_ai: Every compatibility answer is determinable from the file itself.
why_clarity: Works or does not work with a given engine or release is pass or fail.
why_digital: File inspection and catalogue metadata, entirely digital.

why_ai: Demand and supply are fully observed in platform logs, ready for automated analysis.
why_clarity: Unmet demand is measurable, but whether a recommended product sells shows months later.
why_digital: Search and purchase logs turned into creator guidance online.

why_ai: Licence terms are enumerable and checkable once expressed as machine-readable rules.
why_clarity: Permitted uses can be enumerated and checked per asset and project.
why_digital: Licence terms attached to digital delivery and product usage.

why_ai: Unresolved legal question of generated and traced assets grows because of AI.
why_clarity: Provenance rules are unsettled and detection is partial, with no agreed standard.
why_digital: Policy and detection over uploaded digital assets.

why_ai: Search, notice and follow-up for takedowns are all mechanisable.
why_clarity: Takedown notices follow a set procedure, and removal is quickly confirmed.
why_digital: Finding copies online and sending notices to websites.

why_ai: Adjudicating originality between two claimants is ambiguous and removes someone's income.
why_clarity: Two files and two assertions give no objective way to confirm who came first.
why_digital: Reviewing files and claims on a trust and safety console.

why_ai: Explaining automated payout holds and triaging tickets is automatable support work.
why_clarity: The same held-earnings conversation recurs constantly, with resolution visible in tickets.
why_digital: Support handled through tickets and chat with remote creators.
